title: Dynamo AMRAP Blast
description: 10-minute AMRAP with reverse lunges, decline push-ups and sit-ups for maximum endurance

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step backward, lower the knee

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, rise fully to sitting, touch the feet

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower, rise halfway, lower again, then rise fully

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
